name: label
title: Form Label
description: A form label in small bold type sits above an email input and a line of helper text. Focusing the field swaps its faint border for a bright ring.
use: Every form field needs a visible caption tied to its control for sighted users and screen readers.
avoid: Only the caption is styled; the input, placeholder and helper line are demo markup you must build.
a11y: The primitive writes a real label element tied to the control by htmlFor; the focus ring and layout come from the demo markup. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A short bold white caption, 'Email address', above a rounded dark input holding a grey placeholder, with a dim single-line helper note below. When focused, the field's edge becomes a bright thin ring.
behaves: The caption itself never moves. Focusing the field below turns its faint outline into a bright ring, and typed characters replace the placeholder one at a time.
customise: Pass the caption as children and point htmlFor at the field id; restyle with className. Type size, weight and the disabled fade are fixed in the file.
weight: light: One styled text element from a Radix primitive; no animation or script of its own.
